# `mise cache prune`

- **Usage:** `mise cache prune [-v --verbose] [--dry-run] [TOOL]…`
- **Aliases:** `p`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/cache/prune.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/cache/prune.rs)

Remove cache files that have not been accessed recently

Removes cache files not accessed within the `cache_prune_age` setting. Set it to
`0s` to keep cache files indefinitely. mise also prunes the cache now and then
on its own.

## Arguments
- **`[TOOL]…`** — Only prune the cache of these tools, such as `node`

## Flags
- **`-v --verbose`** — Show pruned files
- **`--dry-run`** — Show what would be pruned without deleting anything
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List what would be removed

```
mise cache prune --dry-run
```
